method_card.title: Daily Routine and Healthy Living
method_card.content:
This lesson covers reflexive verbs for your daily routine and obligation structures for talking about healthy habits. You need to know levantarse and other reflexive verbs, plus three ways to express obligation: deber, tener que, and hay que.

SpanishEnglish
levantarseto get up
acostarseto go to bed
despertarseto wake up
lavarseto wash (oneself)
cepillarse los dientesto brush one's teeth
vestirseto get dressed
descansarto rest
la saludhealth
sano/ahealthy
en formafit, in shape
una dieta equilibradaa balanced diet
deber + infinitivemust / should
tener que + infinitiveto have to
deberíaI should (conditional)
hay que + infinitive (Higher)one must / it is necessary to

Grammar focus — reflexive verbs: Reflexive verbs need a reflexive pronoun before the verb. Me levanto a las siete (I get up at seven). The pronoun changes with the subject: me, te, se, nos, os, se. Never drop the pronoun: levanto is wrong; me levanto is correct.

Grammar focus — obligation: Three structures all require the infinitive that follows: Debo comer mejor (I must eat better), Tengo que dormir más (I have to sleep more), Hay que hacer ejercicio (One must exercise). A common error is writing a conjugated verb instead of the infinitive: *debo como is wrong — the correct form is debo comer.

Model: Me levanto a las siete y me ducho. Para mantenerse en forma, hay que comer una dieta equilibrada y hacer ejercicio. Debería dormir ocho horas cada noche. (I get up at seven and have a shower. To keep fit, one must eat a balanced diet and exercise. I should sleep eight hours every night.)
steps: Learn the reflexive verbs for daily routine — always include the reflexive pronoun
Master three obligation structures: deber, tener que, and hay que — all take the infinitive
Use frequency expressions: siempre, normalmente, a veces, nunca
Practice building sentences that combine routine verbs with health advice

exam_context.frequency: Core topic — daily routine and healthy living appear every year

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: Me levanto a las siete y desayuno cereales.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Me levanto = I get up. Notice the reflexive pronoun me before the verb.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: a las siete = at seven. desayuno cereales = I have cereal for breakfast.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: I get up at seven and have cereal for breakfast.

worked_examples.question: What is wrong with: Debo como más fruta cada día.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Debo is a modal verb (I must/should). After any modal verb, the next verb must be an infinitive.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: como is the present-tense conjugated form (I eat). It cannot follow a modal verb.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: The correct form is Debo comer más fruta cada día. After modal verbs, always use the infinitive comer, not the conjugated como.

worked_examples.question: Translate to Spanish: 'I should get up earlier and I have to go to bed before midnight.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: 'I should' = Debería (conditional of deber). 'get up' = the reflexive verb levantarse — infinitive stays attached: Debería levantarme más temprano.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: 'I have to' = tengo que. 'go to bed' = acostarme. 'before midnight' = antes de medianoche.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Debería levantarme más temprano y tengo que acostarme antes de medianoche.

bronze.question: Match the Spanish daily routine verbs to their English meaning
Match the Spanish health phrases to their English meaning

gaps.correct_explain: se debe + infinitive = one should. This is an impersonal obligation structure.

wrong.debo: debo means 'I must' (personal). Se requires the impersonal third-person singular → debe.
wrong.deben: deben is the ellos form (they must). The impersonal se takes third-person singular → debe.

gaps.correct_explain: hacer is the infinitive. After se debe, always use the infinitive.

wrong.hace: hace is conjugated (he/she does). After se debe, use the infinitive → hacer.
wrong.hago: hago is the yo form (I do). After modal verbs, use the infinitive → hacer.

bronze.question: Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: que dormir ocho horas cada noche para

gaps.correct_explain: Tengo que = I have to. Tener que + infinitive expresses personal obligation.

wrong.Tiene: Tiene is the él/ella form (he/she has to). The subject is 'I' → Tengo.
wrong.Debo: Debo means 'I must/should' — grammatically valid but this gap requires Tengo (que dormir).

gaps.correct_explain: mantenerse en forma = to keep fit. After para (in order to), use the infinitive.

wrong.mantiene: mantiene is conjugated. After para, use the infinitive → mantenerse.

bronze.question: What does 'Debería hacer más ejercicio' mean?
options: I want to do more exercise

bronze.source_text: Normalmente me levanto a las siete. Desayuno cereales y bebo un zumo de naranja.
model_answers: I normally get up at seven. I have cereal for breakfast and drink an orange juice.

silver.question: Complete the sentence
silver.english: I should sleep more and I have to avoid fast food.

gaps.correct_explain: Debería = I should (conditional of deber). More tentative than debo (I must).
tengo que = I have to. Personal obligation with tener que.

wrong.tiene: tiene is he/she has to. The subject is 'I' → tengo.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: Por las mañanas me levanto y lavo la cara.
silver.explanation: Lavarse is a reflexive verb. You must include the reflexive pronoun me: me lavo la cara. Without me, the sentence is incomplete.
silver.translation: In the mornings I get up and wash my face.

silver.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
silver.english: One should eat a balanced diet to keep fit.

distractor_labels.come: wrong form — after se debe, use the infinitive comer, not the conjugated form come

silver.source_text: I try to eat a balanced diet. I do sport three times a week but I should sleep more.
model_answers: Intento comer una dieta equilibrada. Hago deporte tres veces a la semana pero debería dormir más.

silver.audio_text: Me acuesto tarde y tengo que levantarme temprano para ir al instituto.
silver.correct_text: Me acuesto tarde y tengo que levantarme temprano para ir al instituto.
silver.translation: I go to bed late and I have to get up early to go to school.

silver.question: Put these words in the correct order to form a sentence

gold.source_text: To keep fit, one should eat a balanced diet and do exercise regularly. I must admit that sometimes I eat too much fast food. I should improve my routine in the future.
model_answers: Para mantenerse en forma, se debe comer una dieta equilibrada y hacer ejercicio con regularidad. Debo admitir que a veces como demasiada comida rápida. Debería mejorar mi rutina en el futuro.

gold.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
gold.english: I should do more exercise and I have to drink more water.

distractor_labels.hago: wrong form — after debería, use infinitive hacer not conjugated hago
distractor_labels.debo: wrong meaning — debo means 'I must', but the English says 'I should' → debería
distractor_labels.bebo: wrong form — after tengo que, use infinitive beber not conjugated bebo

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are at a leisure centre in Spain and speak to a fitness advisor about your routine and health goals.

bullets.prompt: Say what you normally do in the mornings before school.
bullets.model_answer: Normalmente me levanto a las siete, me ducho y desayuno cereales con leche.
bullets.note: reflexive verb me levanto + me ducho + present tense routine

bullets.prompt: Say what exercise you do and how often.
bullets.model_answer: Hago deporte tres veces a la semana. Los fines de semana juego al fútbol.
bullets.note: hacer + deporte + frequency phrase; jugar al fútbol (definite article)

bullets.prompt: Explain one unhealthy habit you have and what you should do to improve.
bullets.model_answer: A veces como demasiada comida rápida. Debería comer más fruta y verdura.
bullets.note: frequency adverb + unhealthy habit + conditional debería + infinitive

bullets.prompt: Ask the advisor what you have to do to get fitter.
bullets.model_answer: ¿Qué tengo que hacer para mejorar mi forma física?
bullets.note: question with ¿Qué...? + tener que + infinitive mejorar

gold.question: Listen and type what you hear
gold.audio_text: Para mantenerse en forma, se debe comer una dieta equilibrada y hacer ejercicio con regularidad. No se debe fumar.
gold.correct_text: Para mantenerse en forma, se debe comer una dieta equilibrada y hacer ejercicio con regularidad. No se debe fumar.
gold.translation: To keep fit, one should eat a balanced diet and exercise regularly. One should not smoke.

gold.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
gold.sentence: Tengo que beber más agua y debo hacer ejercicio pero no puedo fumo.
gold.explanation: After the modal verb poder (puedo = I can), you must use the infinitive → fumar, not the conjugated fumo.
gold.translation: I have to drink more water and I must exercise but I cannot smoke.
